releaseTitle: DCEAY v2.0.0 — Complete Ground-Up Rebuild: One App, All Your Music
changelog:
DCEAY v2.0.0 Complete New Application:
• Brand-New DCEAY 5-Tab Interface & Visual Identity (No legacy UI).
• 01. Cover-to-Background Engine: Live album cover dynamic blur, RGB color sampling, and ambient glow.
• 02. Syllable-by-Syllable Synced Lyrics Studio: Real-time syllable & word karaoke highlight, translation toggle, ms offset calibration, and LRC timestamp studio.
• 03. Universal Link Engine & Smart Playlist Import: Paste YouTube video/music, YouTube playlists, Spotify tracks, Spotify playlists, and direct Hi-Fi audio (.mp3/.flac/.wav/.m4a).
• 04. Android Home-Screen App Icon Switcher: 4 native <activity-alias> launcher icons (Electric Default, Cyberpunk Neon, Liquid Glass, Stealth Monochrome).
• 05. Personalization Studio: Cyberpunk (#ff00ff & #00ffff with double borders), Glassmorphism (#14141e99, #e6e6e6, #ffffff1a), Midnight Electric, and Cover Aurora.
